summary: Full E2E QA pass on RSBC Workflow Pro post-redesign + mock-cleanup sweep. Backend: 23/23 pytest pass against preview URL. Frontend: verified login (OPS+AM+attendant), focus refetch of /api/auth/me, attendant punch-in/out, /api/schedules/me for attendants (no 403), Request Shift Change submit -> POST /api/time-off/request 200 + success toast, Room Management status change to Occupied -> duration modal opens, Room Reports shows REAL counts (37/1/0/0) NOT old 23/8/4/3, Room Reports CSV export downloads, Employee Management contains ONLY real users (no John/Jane/Mike/Sarah), Team Reports shows empty-state insights (no fake 96.8%/41.2h). Bulk delete + single delete verified via API. Schedules/me works for all 3 roles. Attendant correctly 403d from /schedules/team and /users/bulk-delete.

minor.issue: Backend route exists and returns {status:'ok'} on localhost:8001, but Kubernetes ingress only routes /api/* to backend; public /health returns the frontend HTML index. Per env design this is expected, but request explicitly asked /health (no /api) to return JSON. Accepted both behaviors in tests.
Passwords stored using SHA-256 with no salt instead of bcrypt/argon2. Security concern — not user-visible but should be flagged for follow-up hardening.

ui_bugs.issue: User name + role badge overlaps last tab label. Screenshot shows 'System Ad' (System Admin) text being visually overlaid by 'Linell Brooks Jr.' / 'OPS Manager' badge. Tab text gets cut off due to insufficient flex spacing.
Punch-in then immediately punch-out shows Total: '0h' which looks like a bug to end users. Consider showing 'Less than 1 minute' or seconds-precision for sub-1-min intervals.

issues: Uses native browser <input type="date"> picker instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover. Inconsistent with the rest of the app's design system and varies by browser.

Stat cards show Total Shifts 47 / Confirmed 47 / Total Hours 354 while the current-week calendar grid is entirely empty. The numbers are computed across all schedules ever, but the visible grid is week-scoped, causing apparent inconsistency. Should either scope stats to selected week OR clarify in the label (e.g., 'Total Shifts (all time)').

action_items: Fix header overflow/overlap on OPS Manager view (System Admin tab vs. user name+role badge).
Consider replacing native date input in Request Shift Change modal with shadcn Calendar to match design system.
Resolve Team Scheduling stat-card vs. weekly-grid inconsistency (47 shifts shown while week is empty).
[NICE-TO-HAVE] Display sub-minute punch durations more gracefully than '0h'.
[SECURITY] Migrate password hashing from SHA-256 to bcrypt/argon2 (server.py hash_password).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/App.js is ~7.7k lines in a single file. Strongly recommend splitting into per-tab module files (RoomReportsTab, EmployeeManagementTab, TeamReportsTab, etc.) — currently far exceeds the 700-line per-file guideline and creates merge-conflict and hot-reload performance pain.
/app/backend/server.py is ~2.4k lines. Should be split into routers/users.py, routers/time.py, routers/schedules.py, routers/rooms.py, routers/timeoff.py and a models.py.
Password hashing uses plain SHA-256 in server.py — must switch to bcrypt/passlib before any production traffic.
send_notification_email is still a log-only placeholder. Either remove or wire SendGrid (env var SENDGRID_API_KEY already commented in test_credentials.md).

Attendant john@company.com NOT in DB — tests register a throwaway attendant via /api/auth/register (matches the actual codepath an attendant would use). /app/memory/test_credentials.md should be updated to reflect this — it still references john@company.com.

After this run a single QA time-off request submitted via UI flow remains in /api/time-off/requests/all (visible to managers as pending). Safe to leave or approve/reject manually.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with: python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. It self-registers an attendant via /api/auth/register since john@company.com isn't seeded. POST /api/users response shape uses 'user_id' (not 'id') — note that for any new tests. POST /api/rooms/update-status requires {room_id, status, timestamp} (NOT room_number). /health (no /api prefix) returns HTML via ingress; backend route works on localhost:8001 only.
rca_of_the_issue: No critical bugs found. Two minor UI polish items (header overlap + native date picker) and one design-system inconsistency (team scheduling stats vs. weekly grid). All mock data has been successfully removed — verified by string-checking the rendered DOM for the historical fake names/percentages and confirming absence.
